name: StateBlock
purpose: The three states that are not the happy path: nothing to show, fetching, broke.
notFor: A validation message on a single field — that is the field's own error
A transient confirmation — that is Toast
A blocking failure that needs a decision — that is Dialog

anatomy.note: role varies by state; see aria.announcements. data-state mirrors the prop for tests.
Not a heading: this block can appear inside a table cell, where a heading would corrupt the document outline.
Collapsed. Available to whoever needs a correlation id, invisible to everyone else.

state.meaning: which of the three non-happy paths this is

title.note: One line, sentence case, no trailing period.

description.note: Say what the user can do, not what the server did.

action.note: The single most useful next step. Omit rather than invent one.

scope.meaning: how much vertical room it claims
scope.note: Named 'density' until 4.0, where density was reserved for row spacing across Table and DescriptionList.

keyboard.Tab: Reaches the action, then the secondary action, then the diagnostics summary. The block itself is not focusable.

aria.role: status when loading, alert when error, none when empty
aria.labelling: The title is the accessible name of the region when a live role is present.
aria.focus: Never steals focus. A block that grabs focus on render interrupts whatever the user was doing.
aria.announcements: loading is polite (role=status) because it is transient and must not interrupt reading. error is assertive (role=alert) because the user's action did not happen. empty gets no live region at all — it is the rendered result of a successful request, and announcing it is noise. Getting this wrong in either direction is a real failure, which is why it is a component and not a guideline.

content.title: Sentence case, no trailing period. 'No invoices yet', not 'No Invoices Found.'
content.error: Say what did not happen and whether data changed: 'We could not load your invoices. Your data has not changed.' Never 'Something went wrong'.
content.empty: Distinguish 'nothing yet' from 'nothing matches these filters' — they need different actions.
